tools.name: get_current_date
tools.description: Get today's date and weekday. Call this first whenever the user uses relative dates such as 'tomorrow', 'next Friday' or 'in two weeks'.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a study task, assignment or exam-prep item to the planner.

title.description: Short name of the task, e.g. 'Heat Transfer assignment 3'.

subject.description: Course or subject the task belongs to.

est_hours.description: Estimated total hours of work needed (greater than 0).

priority.description: 1 (low), 2 (normal) or 3 (high). Breaks ties between same-deadline tasks.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the planner, sorted by deadline.

tools.name: log_progress
tools.description: Record hours the student has just spent on a task. The task is marked done automatically once its estimate is reached.

hours_done.description: Hours completed in this session (greater than 0).

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently remove a task from the planner.

task_id.description: Id of the task to delete.

tools.name: set_daily_hours
tools.description: Set how many hours per day the student can study.

tools.name: block_date
tools.description: Mark a date as unavailable for studying (travel, festival, event).

tools.name: generate_schedule
tools.description: Build a day-by-day study schedule for all pending tasks using the planner algorithm, save it, and report tasks at risk of missing their deadline. Call again after any change to tasks, hours or blocked dates.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string means today.

days.description: Number of days to plan, 1 to 60.

tools.name: get_plan_for_day
tools.description: Get the saved study plan for one day.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty string means today.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read a text file (e.g. a syllabus or deadline list) from the data/inputs folder so tasks can be extracted from it.
